question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

I want you to check if I have _______ an order or not.
solution:
The correct answer is '**placed**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**placed**" means to put in a particular position or order. (रखा हुआ)
 
• In the context of orders, it commonly means to have made an order or arranged for it.
 
• The other options: "**pushed**," "**made**," and "**sited**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I want you to check if I have placed__ an order or not.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Pushed (धक्का दिया हुआ)**: means to apply force to move something away.
 
• **Made (बनाया हुआ)**: means to create or bring something into existence.
 
• **Sited (स्थापित)**: means to fix or build something in a particular place.
